objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-isovalent-pods-running-offensive-tools
objects.description: The following analytic detects execution of known offensive tooling from within Kubernetes pods, including network scanners and post-exploitation frameworks (e.g., nmap, masscan, zmap, impacket-*, hashcat, john, SharpHound, kube-hunter, peirates). We have created a macro named `linux_offsec_tool_processes` that contains the list of known offensive tooling found on linux systems.
